notes.title: SECOND WIND AND THE ALWAYS IN MIND DEMO
notes.notes:
We invited our friends Marty and Frost at Second Wind to play the demo as a way to celebrate the first day of Next Fest!

Hopefully some of you got the chance to chat with them about all things Always in Mind during the stream. Regardless, you should definitely try the demo yourself and enjoy it for yourself. 

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/kDyuN983rM]join our discord[/url] to share your thoughts and stay up to date on other fun activities, events, and exclusive assets we love to share with our tight-knit community.

Here's to an awesome fun-filled Next Fest and beyond!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATED FOR NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
[h2]In anticipation of Steam Next Fest, the team has been busy improving upon the initial demo release.[/h2]

[h2]Sound Design[/h2]
All-new music tracks, captivating ambience, and improved sound design better capture the beauty of the mind and the emotions of the heart.

[h2]Camera Work[/h2]
Improved cameras provide a smoother and more satisfying experience. Whether playing in the massive open areas or a tight hallways, navigating the world is a breeze.

[h2]Run That Line Again[/h2]
Updated voice-acting and improved narrative elements deliver a more compelling & authentic experience.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
A litany of other small changes and fixes improve quality across the board, and make playing the demo a second time highly recommended.

notes.title: ALWAYS IN MIND NEXT FEST LIVE STREAM #2

[/h1][/b]

notes.title: ALWAYS IN MIND NEXT FEST LIVE STREAM #1

[h1]SPEND TIME WITH THE STUDIO HEAD
